# Sania Shamsi — AI Visibility Technical Portfolio

> Portfolio demonstrating web development experience and a practical implementation of structured data and AI visibility foundations.

## Structured data
The website uses JSON-LD with Schema.org Person, WebSite and WebPage entities. The structured data describes the visible page content.

## Important context
This is an independent portfolio demonstration, not a client website. It does not claim guaranteed rankings, citations or inclusion in AI search systems.
